title: Quantity and Collective Subject Agreement
goal: Choose singular or plural verbs accurately after bare collective nouns and partitive phrases in data prose.
grammar: agreement with collective nouns and partitives

items: I can keep a singular verb after a bare collective noun such as *la gente*, *la población* or *el alumnado*.
I can use either singular or plural agreement after a partitive with a plural noun, choosing the focus on unit or individuals.
I can keep the definite article after *de* in partitive expressions such as *la mayoría de los encuestados*.
